status: Root correction deployed. Bandwidth objective remains active and incomplete.

root_cause.observed: 114 of 811 HOST TX records had wrong WLAN DA/SA/EtherType. All 114 payload DMA cookies were in 0x12000000..0x120fffff; the other 697 headers were correct. All 114 transmissions later repeated with correct headers.
root_cause.cause: The PE CPU treated a PCIe DMA cookie as a PE-addressable pointer. PE ATU maps 0x120xxxxx to PCIe1 IO, so dereferencing it reads IO instead of host DDR.
root_cause.implementation: Copy HOST Ethernet/raw-QoS header into the WP-owned PE-shared header buffer before publishing the request. PE reads that staging buffer and treats HOST payload DMA cookies as opaque PCIe addresses. Map/unmap payloads on the consuming PCIe device.

lifecycle_correction.cause: AP stop paused TX/closed RX before releasing NI route netdev references. unregister_netdevice then waited before tx_free could release the reference.
lifecycle_correction.implementation: Withdraw NI route while RX and RPQ are still running, before TX pause and RX teardown.
lifecycle_correction.verification_limit: Focused actual-stop-body regression passes. A live unload with active NI forwarding has not yet been reverified.

validation.linked_MIPS_regression: scripts/test_pe_host_headers.py: actual firmware; observed 0x1203xxxx IO shadow for both Ethernet and raw QoS. Old binary fails; new passes.
validation.stop_order_regression: scripts/test_radio_stop_route.py: old fails; corrected source passes.

post_fix_live_headers.limit: Live post-fix allocations did not hit the shadow window. The linked-production-firmware regression covers that window.

validation.remaining_loss: Same live trace still had 1893 iperf3 TCP retransmissions and 196.21 Mbps. This correction is not full bandwidth acceptance.

deployment.rejected_candidates: 28-bit PE mask variants 3d4ab66 and d6cdf395 failed -EIO. The extra mask change was removed completely; pe_probe.h matches HEAD.
